reviews.text: I am very happy with Amenity Pool Services. I have used them for the past couple of years and hope to continue. Friendly,  knowledgeable, respectful, and responsive. And a very nice pool.
reviews.author: TH Cass

reviews.text: Amenity pool service is a great business. They take real good care of us and our pool. Andrew B went above and beyond for us on a service call. Fixed our problem fast and then took the time to look up some accessories for me on his own time. I definitely recommend them!
reviews.author: uptony1

reviews.text: We have been customers with Clearly Poolman for several months now, and couldn’t be more satisfied. Previous companies never could seem to keep our filter pressure where it should be, but now that we have Chelsea as our regular technician, I can go out to my pool anytime and the flow is always exactly where it’s supposed to be. Chelsea is phenomenal and a great asset to the company. She continuously goes above and beyond to provide too tier service, answers any questions we may have, and leaves our pool sparkling every week! Thank you for your professionalism, and putting your heart into all you do!
reviews.author: PhoenixPlayz

reviews.text: We were previous customers of the pool company that Amenity acquired, and Amenity is a much better run operation. They are on top of the cleanings and their maintenance staff is great and knowledgeable too. Shoutout to Andrew B for our last service call, he got things fixed quickly.
reviews.author: Kevin Maher

reviews.text:
I have revised rating from 2⭐️ to 4⭐️. Amenity Pool Services has improved on maintaining the schedule. If they are able to maintain the weekly schedule, I may change my rating to 5⭐️.
-------------------
We have been with Amenity Pool Services for 6-years;; up until about February 2025 the service was excellent. Since then, the reliability of Amenity Pools has gone down quite noticeably. It has become necessary to call/email on a regular basis to ask if our pool would be serviced on the day it is scheduled (Wednesday). Originally, the manager Michelle was responsive to inquiries, however, she no longer will reply to calls/emails regarding questions for servicing. I hate the thought of hiring a new provider but I am tired of paying for a service not received or staff not willing to discuss the situation. Communications is valuable and necessary. It is sad this company has allowed for such a drastic decline of service to their paying customers.
----------------------
November 7, 2025: Communication is everything to a customer; lack of is simply apathy. No service yesterday, no mass email to explain why. Today the GM indicated the employee quit on Wednesday which would have allowed time to be pro-active with paying customers. I promised I would revise my overall rating provided service was maintained. I have reduced my rating to 3⭐️ and it is more so because of lack of communications.
reviews.author: Steven L Bayes

reviews.text: We’ve been very pleased with Amenity Pool Services since we moved into our home in the spring and became a customer. A friend highly recommended this company, and I’m so grateful she did. Brice has done a great job keeping our pool clean and chemically balanced for us! We also got great service with an affordable repair after wind ripped off our neighbor’s shed roof and it hit our pump at just the right angle to break a pipe—Amenity was here the next day and we were back in the pool right away!
reviews.author: Bryan and Jennifer Bellamy

reviews.text: Andrew was great to work with! He gave me a heads up before arrival, listened to my concerns, and completed the replacement in a timely manner. When he completed the work, he went over all the details with me, and checked the other pool equipment. Andrew shared concerns that we should be keeping an eye on - and was just a pleasant, positive person!
reviews.author: Susan Kaufman

reviews.text:
We have been with this company for many years and never had a problem until recently. The last year has been the worst pool service we have ever had. All the techs have left and the new techs don't seem to be properly trained or concerned with showing up consistently. After calling and emailing for a month without an real communication on their part, we were finally promised better service (green algae was building up along the walls and we were still putting in our own chemicals). We then left for a two week vacation and came back to a swamp (see photos below). As you can imagine, we were furious! After two phone calls and multiple photos emailed, a supervisor contacted us and assured us he would handle it himself and make it right. We'll, that was a joke. He stopped by and threw in some chlorine tabs and left. Never heard from him again. Three unanswered text messages later and we said take us off your client list. Of course, we were then contacted through email with a bill of $37 ... in their words, "For the week your pool wasn't green"... SERIOUSLY?!?!

If you are smart you will run far away from this company!
reviews.author: Brandi Roland
